example.cn: 如果症状持续的话，马上咨询医生。

example.cn: 她脖子上戴了条金项链。

example.cn: 她是该队中表现最为稳定的选手。

enDef: a place in a factory, school etc where meals are provided, usually quite cheaply

example.cn: 伦尼已在食堂吃过晚饭。

example.cn: 他甚至没有过来向我祝贺。

example.cn: 言论自由的权利被写入美国宪法。

example.cn: 红色的丝绒窗帘

enDef: a small flat plastic case containing  magnetic tape  , that can be used for playing or recording sound

example.cn: 他以磁带形式发行的两张专辑已售出1000万份。

enDef: to make light or a shadow appear somewhere

enDef: a complete list of things that you can look at, buy, or use, for example in a library or at an art show

enDef: a group of people or things that are all of the same type

example.en: people in the over-45 age category
example.cn: 属45岁以上年龄组的人

cn: 投合，迎合；满足需要；提供饮食及服务
enDef: to provide and serve food and drinks at a party, meeting etc, usually as a business

example.cn: 我们满足一个特殊客户群的需求。

enDef: a solid object with six equal square sides

example.en: a sugar cube
example.cn: 一块方糖

enDef: the main church of a particular area under the control of a  bishop

example.en: St Paul’s Cathedral
example.cn: 圣保罗大教堂

enDef: cows and  bull s  kept on a farm for their meat or milk

example.en: herds of cattle
example.cn: 成群的牛

enDef: a room under a house or other building, often used for storing things

example.cn: …一块小小的植物化石，只有几厘米高。

enDef: in the middle of an area or an object

example.cn: 学位证书

example.en: Lucy stretched up to kiss his cheek.

example.en: the organic chemicals industry
example.cn: 有机化学工业

cn: 化学家；化学工作者；药剂师；炼金术士
enDef: a scientist who has special knowledge and training in chemistry

example.en: She worked as a research chemist.
example.cn: 她是一名化学研究员。

enDef: a printed piece of paper that you write an amount of money on, sign, and use instead of money to pay for things

example.en: You could write her a cheque .

enDef: a baby bird

example.en: a mother hen with her chicks
example.cn: 和小鸡在一起的鸡妈妈

enDef: the period of time when you are a child

example.en: I had a very happy childhood.
example.cn: 我的童年很快乐。

example.en: We can’t light a fire because the chimney hasn’t been swept.
example.cn: 烟囱管没有清扫过，我们生不了火。

cn: [食品] 炸土豆条；小木片；（作赌注用的）圆形筹码；缺口（chip的复数形式）

example.en: ...an electronic card containing a chip.
example.cn: …一张带有芯片的电子卡。

enDef: a group of people who sing together for other people to listen to

example.en: He joined a church choir at the age of eight.
example.cn: 他八岁时加入了一个教堂唱诗班。

cn: 呛；使窒息；阻塞；抑制；扑灭

example.en: I felt as if there was a weight on my chest, choking me.
example.cn: 我感觉好像有重物压在胸口，让我喘不过气来。

enDef: a large group of people who sing together

example.en: I sing with the university chorus.
example.cn: 我在大学合唱队里唱歌。

cn: 体贴的， 考虑周到的； 替人着想的
enDef: always thinking of what other people need or want and being careful not to upset them

example.en: He was always kind and considerate.
example.cn: 他总是很善良，为别人着想。

enDef: a person who believes in the ideas taught by Jesus Christ

example.en: He was a devout Christian.
example.cn: 他曾是一个虔诚的基督教徒。

example.cn: 他在抽一只大雪茄。

example.cn: 他们在五月份举行了世俗婚礼。

example.en: Reporters asked him to clarify his position (= say exactly what his beliefs are ) on welfare reform.
example.cn: 记者们要求他阐明他在福利改革问题上的立场。

cn: 经典的；古典的，传统的；最优秀的
enDef: having all the features that are typical or expected of a particular thing or situation

example.en: The Coca-Cola bottle is one of the classic designs of the last century.
example.cn: 可口可乐瓶是上个世纪的经典设计之一。

cn: 古典的；经典的；传统的；第一流的
enDef: belonging to a traditional style or set of ideas

example.en: the classical theory of relativity
example.cn: 经典相对论

cn: [化工] 清洁剂；清洁工；干洗店；干洗商；洗洁器

example.en: a vacuum cleaner
example.cn: 真空吸尘器

cn: 清晰地；明显地；无疑地；明净地

example.cn: 忽视他显然是个错误。

example.cn: 洛杉矶温暖干燥的气候

example.cn: 用一块湿布清洗表面。

example.en: A cock crowed in the distance.
example.cn: 远处有只公鸡在打鸣。

example.en: He grabbed me by the collar.

example.cn: 她的目光突然和他相遇，她微微有点脸红了。

example.cn: 你的头发需要好好梳理一下。

example.cn: 我们必须把利润和贸易增长作为我们的第一要务。

example.cn: 女性犯罪比男性少。

example.cn: 你是否准备好作出长久的承诺？

example.cn: …共产主义在全世界的最终胜利。

example.cn: 如果没有法国的共产主义者，二战中的抵抗运动可能不会成功。

example.cn: 因为我左眼视力差，右眼就要辛苦点来弥补一下。

example.cn: 复杂的公路网

example.en: She admitted that she was unable to compromise.
example.cn: 她承认自己无法作出妥协。

example.cn: 强制性裁员的威胁

enDef: to decide that something is true after considering all the information you have

example.cn: 等到调查结束后，结果会被送到联邦检察官办公室。

example.en: These are the report’s main conclusions.
example.cn: 这些就是这篇报告的主要结论。

cn: 混凝土的；实在的，具体的；有形的
enDef: made of concrete

example.en: a concrete floor
example.cn: 混凝土地面

enDef: to say very strongly that you do not approve of something or someone, especially because you think it is morally wrong

example.en: Politicians were quick to condemn the bombing.
example.cn: 政治家们立即对爆炸事件进行了谴责。

cn: 导体；售票员；领导者；管理人

example.en: Wood is a poor conductor of heat.
example.cn: 木头导热性能差。

cn: 确认；确定；证实；批准；使巩固

example.en: New evidence has confirmed the first witness’s story.
example.cn: 新的证据证实了第一个证人的说法。

enDef: a state of disagreement or argument between people, groups, countries etc

example.en: the threat of industrial conflict in the coalfields
example.cn: 煤田发生劳资纠纷的风险

enDef: to make someone feel that they cannot think clearly or do not understand

example.en: I understand the text but the diagrams are confusing me.
example.cn: 文字我理解，但是图表把我弄糊涂了。

enDef: when you tell someone that you are happy because they have achieved something or because something nice has happened to them

example.en: letters of congratulation
example.cn: 祝贺信

example.cn: 到目前为止警方尚未确定两宗凶杀案之间有关联。

example.cn: 欧盟财政部长会议未能就一体化的进度达成共识。

example.cn: 野生生物保护

example.cn: 对待教育非常守旧的态度

example.cn: 我的饮食几乎只包含裹上巧克力的曲奇饼和一杯杯牛奶。

enDef: the process of building things such as houses, bridges, roads etc

example.en: a road construction project
example.cn: 道路修建计划

cn: 包含；控制；容纳；牵制（敌军）

example.en: The thieves stole a purse containing bank-notes.
example.cn: 小偷们偷到了一个里面有钞票的钱包。

enDef: something such as a box or bowl that you use to keep things in

example.en: ice cream in plastic containers
example.cn: 塑料容器里的冰激凌

cn: 同时代的人；同时期的东西

example.cn: 像我同时代的大多数人一样，我在一个非常不同的世界里长大。

example.en: water with a low salt content
example.cn: 含盐量低的水

enDef: a large mass of land surrounded by sea

example.en: the continents of Asia and Africa
example.cn: 亚洲及非洲大陆

example.cn: 3个儿子也为家族企业做贡献。

example.cn: 竞选捐款

enDef: a piece of equipment that is cordless is not connected to its power supply by wires

example.en: a cordless phone
example.cn: 无线电话

example.en: Ready meals sell well because of their convenience.
example.cn: 即食餐因为方便销路好。

cn: 信用； 信赖； 贷方
enDef: an arrangement with a shop, bank etc that allows you to buy something and pay for it later

example.en: The store agreed to let him have credit.
example.cn: 商店同意他赊购。

cn: 符合习俗的，传统的；常见的；惯例的

example.cn: 他的案子已变成了公民自由活动家们和政府之间的争论缘由。

example.en: I make ceramic cups there. Do you remember the gift I gave you for your last birthday? Those two cups?
example.cn: 在那里，我可以自己制作陶瓷茶杯。还记得你上次生日时我送你的礼物吗？那两个茶杯？

example.en: officials charged with bribery and corruption
example.cn: 被指控受贿和贪污的官员

enDef: an action taken to prevent another action from having a harmful effect

example.en: new countermeasures against terrorism
example.cn: 对抗恐怖主义的新措施

example.cn: 这场比赛的现场直播

example.cn: 气体储存在圆筒内。

example.cn: 参加的最重要标准就是申请人必须设计并制作自己的作品。

cn: 宇宙的；广大无边的，极大的

example.en: the cosmic laws governing our world
example.cn: 主宰我们世界的宇宙法则

enDef: the whole universe, especially when you think of it as a system

example.cn: …宇宙的自然法则。

example.cn: 员工们总是彬彬有礼、乐于帮助。

example.cn: 法官的判决基于一个常识性原则，即谁也不能凌驾于法律之上。

example.en: wire cutters
example.cn: 钢丝钳，铁丝剪

enDef: someone who settles in a new colony

example.en: The colonists struggled through their first winter.
example.cn: 这些殖民地居民艰难地度过了第一个冬天。

enDef: consecutive numbers or periods of time follow one after the other without any interruptions

example.en: It had rained for four consecutive days.
example.cn: 雨接连下了四天。

example.cn: 这个新软件与IBM的计算机兼容。

enDef: a group of things of the same kind that are very close together

example.en: a diamond cluster ring
example.cn: 群镶钻戒

enDef: a small bed for a baby, especially one that moves gently from side to side

example.en: She rocked the cradle to quieten the child.
example.cn: 她摇动摇篮，让宝宝安静下来。

example.en: the compression of air
example.cn: 空气的压缩

enDef: being one of the parts of something

example.en: the EU and its constituent members
example.cn: 欧盟及其成员国

cn: 创造， 创建； 创造的作品， 产物； 宇宙， 天地万物
enDef: the act of creating something

example.en: a job creation scheme
example.cn: 创造就业机会的计划

enDef: a sea animal with a hard shell, five legs on each side, and two large claws

example.en: crab meat
example.cn: 蟹肉

enDef: the number by which an unknown quantity is multiplied

example.en: In 8pq, the coefficient of pq is 8.
example.cn: 在8pq中pq的系数为8。

enDef: the process of checking or slightly changing an instrument or tool so that it does something correctly

example.en: a calibration error
example.cn: 校准误差

enDef: a large group of families who often share the same name

example.en: the Campbell clan
example.cn: 坎贝尔家族

enDef: a cupboard built into the wall of a room from the floor to the ceiling

example.en: a closet full of beautiful clothes
example.cn: 满是漂亮衣服的壁橱

enDef: to happen at the same time as something else, especially by chance

cn: 鸡尾酒； 餐前开胃小吃； 混合物
enDef: an alcoholic drink made from a mixture of different drinks

example.cn: 到达时，客人们可以享用葡萄酒或一份香槟鸡尾酒。

example.en: Dairy source of protein and calcium.
example.cn: 奶牛的蛋白质来源和钙。

enDef: polite words or good wishes, especially when used to express praise and admiration

example.en: Compliments of the season! (= for Christmas or the New Year)
example.cn: 谨致节日的祝贺！（圣诞节或新年时的贺词）

enDef: the part of mathematics that deals with changing quantities, such as the speed of a falling stone or the slope of a curved line

example.en: We have to factor that into the calculus.
example.cn: 我们要在微积分学中考虑这些因素。

enDef: the state of being finished

example.en: The house is nearing completion (= almost finished ) .
example.cn: 房子即将完工。

enDef: bent, twisted, or not in a straight line

example.en: Your tie’s crooked.
example.cn: 你的领带歪了。

example.en: the medical corps
example.cn: 医疗部队

cn: 乘公交车上下班，经常乘车往返于两地
enDef: to regularly travel a long distance to get to work

example.en: Baldry’s 20-year prison sentence was commuted to three years.
example.cn: 鲍德里二十年的刑期被减至三年。

enDef: something that is customary is normal because it is the way something is usually done

example.en: In some cultures it is customary for the bride to wear white.
example.cn: 在一些文化中，新娘按风俗要穿白色。

enDef: a small church, or a room in a hospital, prison, big church etc in which Christians pray and have religious services

example.en: Bethan goes to chapel every Sunday.
example.cn: 贝唐每个星期天都去教堂做礼拜。

enDef: a black substance made of burned wood that can be used as fuel

example.en: cooking over a charcoal fire
example.cn: 在炭火上做饭

enDef: an official process of counting a country’s population and finding out about the people

example.en: a traffic census
example.cn: 交通状况调查

enDef: the dead body of a person

example.en: The corpse was found by children playing in the woods.
example.cn: 这具尸体是在林子里玩耍的孩子发现的。

enDef: an object in space like a bright ball with a long tail, that moves around the sun

example.en: Halley’s comet
example.cn: 哈雷彗星

enDef: a comfortable piece of furniture big enough for two or three people to sit on

example.en: Tom offered to sleep on the couch.
example.cn: 汤姆说他来睡沙发。

enDef: to examine books, films, letters etc to remove anything that is considered offensive, morally harmful, or politically dangerous etc

example.en: The information given to the press was carefully censored by the Ministry of Defence.
example.cn: 发布给报界的信息经过了国防部的仔细审查。

enDef: to form an idea, a plan, etc. in your mind; to imagine sth

example.en: He conceived the idea of transforming the old power station into an arts centre.
example.cn: 他想出了一个把旧发电站改造为艺术中心的主意。

cn: 结合体， 同盟； 结合， 联合
enDef: a union of two or more political parties that allows them to form a government or fight an election together

example.en: the centre-right coalition government
example.cn: 政治上中间偏右的联合政府

enDef: if a group of people convene, or someone convenes them, they come together, especially for a formal meeting

example.en: a report by experts convened by the National Institutes of Health
example.cn: 由全国健康协会召集的专家提出的一份报告

enDef: the process of burning

example.en: The energy is released by combustion on the application of a match.
example.cn: 能量通过点火柴燃烧释放出来。

enDef: a handle on a piece of equipment, that you can turn in order to move something

example.en: He was idly turning a crank on a strange mechanism strapped to his chest.
example.cn: 他漫不经心地转着绑在他胸前的一个古怪装置上面的曲柄。

enDef: a drug, usually in the form of a white powder, that is taken illegally for pleasure or used in some medical situations to prevent pain

example.en: To investigate, his team injected cocaine, capsaicin or both at once into the abdomens of several groups of about 30 mice.
example.cn: 他的团队将辣椒素或可卡因中的一种，或同时将两种注射进几组老鼠的腹部，每组约30只。

enDef: a discussion in which people who are affected by or involved in something can give their opinions

example.en: They retired to another room for private consultation.
example.cn: 他们退到另一房间秘密磋商。

enDef: the practice of keeping yourself or the things around you clean

example.en: a high standard of cleanliness
example.cn: 很高的卫生标准

enDef: something that limits your freedom to do what you want

example.en: the constraints of family life
example.cn: 家庭生活的约束

enDef: the skill or work of a carpenter

example.en: The carpentry and soldier demand constraints are similar.
example.cn: 木工和士兵的需求约束是类似的。

enDef: deserving or able to be believed or trusted

example.en: Her excuse was barely credible.
example.cn: 她的借口无法让人信服。

enDef: a chemical substance found in your blood. Too much cholesterol in your body may cause heart disease.

example.en: So why would you want to lower your cholesterol?
example.cn: 那么为什么你想降低你的胆固醇呢？

enDef: to officially give someone a title etc, especially as a reward for something they have achieved

example.en: The constitution also confers large powers on Brazil's 25 constituent states.
example.cn: 宪法还授予巴西25个成员州极大的权力。

enDef: someone who competes in a contest

example.en: Later he applied to be a contestant on the television show.
example.cn: 之后他报了名做该电视秀的参赛者。

cn: 结晶； 变得清晰而明确； 使具体化
enDef: if a liquid crystallizes, it forms  crystals

example.en: The liquid will crystallize at 50 degrees centigrade.
example.cn: 这种液体在50摄氏度时结晶。

enDef: happening or existing in many places, and therefore not special or unusual

example.en: Car thefts are commonplace in this part of town.
example.cn: 镇上的这个地段盗车案屡见不鲜。

enDef: to work together with a person or group in order to achieve something, especially in science or art

example.en: Much later he collaborated with his son Michael on the English translation of a text on food production.
example.cn: 后来他和儿子迈克尔合作，把一个有关食品生产的文本翻译成英语。

enDef: a long loose piece of clothing without sleeves that fastens around your neck and hangs from your shoulders

example.en: ...a woollen cape.
example.cn: …一件羊毛披肩。

enDef: related to the process of knowing, understanding, and learning something

example.en: cognitive psychology
example.cn: 认知心理学

cn: 合作， 协作； 勾结
enDef: when you work together with another person or group to achieve something, especially in science or art

example.en: The company is building the centre in collaboration with the Institute of Offshore Engineering.
example.cn: 该公司正与海洋工程学院合建这座中心。

enDef: to lose power, become weak, or fail

example.en: The Empire began to crumble during the 13th century.
example.cn: 这个帝国在13世纪时开始崩溃。

enDef: the natural ability, skill, or power that makes a machine, person, or organization able to do something, especially something difficult

example.en: the country’s manufacturing capability
example.cn: 该国的生产能力

enDef: a chronic disease or illness is one that continues for a long time and cannot be cured

example.en: chronic arthritis
example.cn: 慢性关节炎

enDef: someone who knows a lot about a particular subject, and who writes about it or discusses it on the television or radio

example.cn: 政治评论员

enDef: the clarity of a piece of writing, law, argument etc is its quality of being expressed clearly

example.en: Letters may be edited for length and clarity.
example.cn: 信件可能要加以修改以求篇幅合适，意思明了。

example.cn: 酸性水会腐蚀管子。

enDef: to protect something and prevent it from changing or being damaged

example.en: We must conserve our woodlands for future generations.
example.cn: 我们必须为子孙后代保护林地。

enDef: Someone's or something's counterpart is another person or thing that has a similar function or position in a different place

example.en: As soon as he heard what was afoot, he telephoned his German and Italian counterparts to protest.
example.cn: 他一听到在进行中的事，马上就给德国和意大利相应人员打电话抗议。

enDef: a government official sent to live in a foreign city to help people from his or her own country who are living or staying there

example.en: the British Consul in Paris
example.cn: 英国驻巴黎领事

enDef: increasing gradually as more of something is added or happens

example.en: Learning is a cumulative process.
example.cn: 学习是个逐渐积累的过程。

enDef: a smooth red-brown nut that you can eat

example.en: roast chestnuts
example.cn: 炒栗子

enDef: to limit something

example.en: Poor soil has constrained the level of crop production.
example.cn: 贫瘠的土地限制了农作物的产量。

enDef: polite behaviour and respect for other people

example.en: It’s a matter of common courtesy to acknowledge letters.
example.cn: 确认收到来信是起码的礼貌。

enDef: careful to do everything that it is your job or duty to do

example.cn: 一个认真负责的教师可能会想着把工作带回家去做。

enDef: to understand something that is complicated or difficult

example.cn: 她无法理解这场灾难的严重程度。

example.en: The bushes grew in a compact mass.
example.cn: 灌木长成茂密的一片。

enDef: a connection between two ideas, facts etc, especially when one may be the cause of the other

example.en: ...the correlation between smoking and disease.
example.cn: …吸烟和疾病之间的关联。

cn: 配置， 布局， 构造
enDef: the shape or arrangement of the parts of something

example.cn: …史前巨石柱群，位于英国西南部，是一座古代巨石阵列。

cn: 厚片， 大块； 相当大的部分
enDef: a large thick piece of something that does not have an even shape

example.cn: 大冰块

example.cn: 研究是该职业的基石。

enDef: to begin or to start something

example.en: Work will commence on the new building immediately.
example.cn: 新大楼即将破土动工。

enDef: to state that something is correct or true, especially after some kind of test

example.cn: 这些账目经审计员核实过。

enDef: amusing you and making you want to laugh

example.cn: 滑稽小说

enDef: having a lot of curls or a curved shape

example.cn: 又长又黑的鬈发

enDef: to compete against someone in order to gain something

example.cn: 争权夺利的几个团体之间不可避免地发生了打斗。

example.cn: 除了财产损失之外，洪水还影响了美国一部分最肥沃的耕地，并预计对已经不断增加的粮食价格有所影响，尤其是像玉米这样的农作物。

example.cn: 树篱刚修剪过。

example.cn: 双手洁净是准备食物时的一项最基本要求。

example.cn: 认为人性本恶的一种观点

example.cn: 她用手紧紧地捂住耳朵。

example.cn: 他们发生了争论，结果导致汤姆喝醉了酒。

example.cn: 麦吉尔克拥有爱尔兰和美国的双重国籍。

example.cn: 这两条河在匹兹堡附近汇合。

enDef: either of two things that correlate with each other
made up of different parts or materials

example.en: composite metals
example.cn: 复合金属

enDef: a long box in which a dead person is buried or burnt
a plant grown to produce grain, for example wheat, rice etc

example.en: cereal crops
example.cn: 谷类作物

enDef: used in the official names of some countries, groups of countries, or parts of countries

example.cn: …澳大利亚联邦。

example.cn: 这家公司巩固了作为该国主要煤气供应商的地位。

example.cn: 议会民主的概念

example.cn: 飞机误点给我们的旅行带来了更大的麻烦。

enDef: the state of being complicated

example.en: a design of great complexity
example.cn: 一项非常复杂的设计

example.cn: 它们被喷了油以防腐蚀。

example.cn: 不知不觉我们就来到了墓地入口，他又向我发问。

cn: 肤色， 面色； 局面； 性质

example.cn: 喝水让气色变好。

example.cn: 在英国杜鹃鸟是报春的使者。

enDef: the state of continuing for a period of time, without problems, interruptions, or changes

example.en: We should ensure continuity of care between hospital and home.
example.cn: 我们应当保证医院护理和家庭护理的连续性。

enDef: a hole or space inside something

example.en: Put herbs inside the body cavity of the fish.
example.cn: 把香草放进鱼肚里。

enDef: a piece of equipment that collects and stores electricity

example.en: The second resistor has been replaced by a capacitor.
example.cn: 第二个电阻已由一个电容所代替。

enDef: the property of a system that enables it to store electric charge

example.en: the clatter of horses' hoofs
example.cn: 嗒嗒的马蹄声

enDef: a tube containing explosive powder and a bullet that you put in a gun

example.cn: 5个子弹壳中只有4个被警方收回。

enDef: relating to a large mass of land

example.en: the warming-up of continental interiors
example.cn: 内陆地区的变暖

enDef: (of food) pleasantly hard and dry

example.en: a crisp green salad
example.cn: 脆爽的蔬菜色拉

enDef: a substance that makes a chemical reaction happen more quickly without being changed itself

example.cn: 他们希望他的当选会成为改革的催化剂。

enDef: to praise or approve of someone or something publicly

example.cn: 该报获得了“英国新闻奖”的高度褒奖。

example.cn: 他甚至想过自杀。

example.cn: 传统的烧船仪式将节庆活动推向了高潮。

cn: 净空， 余隙； 许可， 批准； 票据交换， 清算； 清除， 清理， 出空

example.cn: 如果取得了医生的许可，她就会参加比赛。

enDef: thin pieces of the stems of plants, used for making furniture and baskets

example.cn: 藤椅

enDef: a small area in a forest where there are no trees

example.en: A helicopter landed in a clearing in the dense jungle.
example.cn: 一架直升机在茂密丛林中的一片空地着陆了。

enDef: a French white wine with a lot of  bubble s  , drunk on special occasions

example.en: We regaled ourselves on caviar and champagne.
example.cn: 我们尽情地享用鱼子酱和香槟酒。

enDef: someone who wears funny clothes, a red nose, bright make-up on their face etc, and does silly things to make people laugh, especially at a circus

example.en: The performance of the clown kept the public rolling about.
example.cn: 小丑的表演使观众笑得前仰后合。

enDef: a combination of several musical notes that are played at the same time and sound pleasant together

example.cn: 《通往天堂的阶梯》的开篇和弦

enDef: to talk quickly in a friendly way without stopping, especially about things that are not serious or important

example.cn: 她开心地说个不停，直到发觉我没在听才停下来。

enDef: in the same direction as the hands of a clock move
